name: @error-tracker/sdk
description: Browser and Node.js SDK for Error Tracker.

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run build:browser && bun run build:node && bun run build:replay && bun run build:types
scripts.build:browser: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist/browser --target browser --format esm --sourcemap
scripts.build:node: bun run build:node:esm && bun run build:node:cjs
scripts.build:node:esm: bun build src/node.ts --outdir dist/node --entry-naming '[dir]/index.mjs' --target node --format esm --sourcemap
scripts.build:node:cjs: bun build src/node.ts --outdir dist/node --entry-naming '[dir]/index.cjs' --target node --format cjs --sourcemap
scripts.build:replay: bun build src/plugins/replay/index.ts --outdir dist/browser/plugins/replay --target browser --format esm --sourcemap
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run lint && bun test && bun run build && npm pack --dry-run
